name: teamai-cli
one_liner: A tool that lets a whole company share the same AI-assistant settings, rules, and knowledge, so every employee's AI tool behaves the same way and updates automatically.
buyer: An engineering manager at a mid-size company rolling out AI coding assistants org-wide who needs consistency instead of every developer configuring their own ad-hoc rules.
business_use_cases: A software agency standardizes coding rules and review agents across every client project and every AI tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) developers happen to use.
An enterprise IT team pushes security and compliance rules to every engineer's AI assistant from one central repo, with automatic sync.
A consulting firm sells 'AI-native onboarding' services to clients, using this as the delivery mechanism for shared skills and knowledge.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted 'team dashboard' tier with usage analytics and digest reports (the project's own roadmap hints at this) for a per-seat fee.
Sell premium starter templates (industry-specific skills and review agents) via the teamai-hub template marketplace.

steal_this: Build one vertical-specific template repo (e.g. 'fintech compliance skills for AI agents') and list it on teamai-hub to capture teams in that niche first.
